text:
anya_cs: Hey team — Helios kickoff tomorrow. Can someone craft a 5	6-line customer-facing checklist about caching / batching / streaming that I can paste into the calendar invite? Also want a tiny engineer snippet (2lines config + one quick note) and a short list of immediate renewal-risk signals we should watch for in the first 72h.

mike_se: Invite blurb (short, customer-facing):

 Keep responses snappy: enable streaming for interactive UIs so users see tokens as they arrive.
 Use prefix caching for stable system prompts (welcome, identity, policy) to reduce latency and cost.
 Warm a small pool after deploys (2requests) to avoid cold-start tails.
 Batch at the edge when user latency tolerance allows (common sizes: 4 or 8).
 Capture quick thumbs / 1-click satisfaction on generated results to feed ops.


mike_se: Engineer snippet (drop-in):
```yaml
inference:
  warm_pool: 2 # representative requests to pre-warm
  batch:
    max_size: 4
    max_wait_ms: 60
  streaming: true
  prefix_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 1800
```
Note: use smaller batches for chat UIs with low latency needs; increase for async jobs.

tasha_pm: Renewal-risk signals (first 72h watchlist):
 1) p95 latency spikes sustained > 400ms across >2 routes.
 2) Tokens/day per active seat drops > 30% vs baseline (indicates reduced usage).
 3) New or repeated 5xx spikes / queued requests > safe threshold.
 4) Rapid rise in negative feedback flags (>3% of responses) or NPS for the feature drops.
 5) Support tickets about hallucinations or wrong formatting for critical flows.
Also log qualitative notes from the first customer demo — if they ask for heavy rework or say "not fast enough", flag for CSM follow-up.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: check p95/p50, tokens/day, and prefix cache hit-rate at +24h and +72h. :alarm_clock:

pulse-bot: Suggest adding a tiny in-product survey to collect immediate signal: 1) Was this helpful? (yes/no) 2) Rate speed (fast/ok/slow). Capture the yes% and 'slow' rate as early health signals.

anya_cs: This is great  I'll paste the invite text and attach the yaml snippet. I'll set the bot follow-ups and ping eng if any of the risk signals fire. Thanks!
